correctness.rationale: For all eight affine points, the 16 affine Boolean maps form the [8,4,4] code; nontrivial weight-four supports are exactly 14 zero-XOR affine planes. Four-point cyclic support has pair weight 4 plus its number of runs. Four complementary windows and alternating parity planes give coefficients A5=2T and A8=2Z. Each coordinate edge belongs to three plane supports (24 incidences); the remaining A6 and A7 follow from two linear equations. AGL(3,2) has 1344 automorphisms, hence 8!/1344=30 labeled codes. The event calculation and conditional parity-direction matching yield the joint counts. Independently reconstructed every normalized affine order (5040), distinct codebooks, pair weight spectrum and T,Z table: all formulas match; the proof supplies completeness, not only finite spot checks.
